DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA cor. Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq.qov.ph DILG OPINION No. 10 s. 2022 FEB 15 2022 Hon. VENUSTIANO D. JORDAN Municipal Mayor Municipality of La Paz Province of Tarlac Dear Mayor V.D Jordan: This refers to your letter addressed to Director Jay E. Timbreza, DILG-Region Ill, concerning the utilization of project under FY 2019 AM Program. As represented in your letter, the Municipality of La Paz, Tarlac, was a recipient of a grant "AM Project 2019" entitled "Expansion of Level Ill Water System Located at Four (4) Barangays, namely; Caut, Paludpud, Balanoy and Rizal with a Total Project Cost of Php 10,614,000.00. The Municipality of La Paz under its Public—Private Partnership Ordinance, has recently entered with PAMANA Corporation for the joint undertaking of the improvement, development and expansion of La Paz Water System. Hence, your request for guidance concerning the utilization of the aforesaid facility. In reply thereto, we find the attached Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) entered into by and between the Municipality La Paz and PAMANA Water Corporation material in addressing the subject query. After perusal thereof, it appears that the aforesaid Agreement is based on ROT (Rehabilitate-Operate-and-Transfer) scheme. In fact, this is stipulated in the attached Addendum, specifically Item 1 (b) thereof. It is worthy to note that Section 2 (i) of Republic Act No. 7718 defines ROT as "A contractual arrangement whereby an existing facility is turned over to the private sector to refurbish, operate and maintain for a franchise period, at the expiry of which the legal title to the facility is turned over to the government. Xxx" Relative thereto, the following pertinent provisions are culled from the subject MOA, thus: "1. Grant of rights. The First Party [Municipality of La Paz] hereby grants to the Second Patty the right to be the exclusive WSP [Water Service Provider] to finance, develop, rehabilitate, expand, operate, maintain, and manage the La Paz Water Supply System (LWSS) with the following right and discretion to: Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

b. Manage, occupy, repair, decommission, refurbish, operate, and maintain any existing waterworks facility of works including all other facilities that may be deemed necessary; c. Construct, operate, maintain, manage, and acquire ownership of the additional improvements to be introduced into the existing facilities; f. Utilize all water resources within the First Party's territory such as catchment areas, watersheds, springs, wells, and reservoir." 5. xxx "The ownership of the additional properties and improvement to be introduced during the terms of this Agreement shall belong to the Second Party. Upon the expiration of the term of this Agreement and of the concession, said additional properties and improvements shall belong to the First Party." 7. xxx "The term of this Agreement is thirty (30) years beginning the day after the Sangguniang Bayan of the First Party ratifies this Agreement xxx." Accordingly, it is this Department's view that by virtue of subject MOA, the utilization of the facility in question is under the operation and management of the PAMANA Corporation for such period stipulated therein. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have guided you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, E AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: MARLO AN for Local Government OUSLG/MLl/LLLS-LRALLD/jam Dir. KARL CAESAR R. RIMANDO, CESO Ill Regional Director, DILG-III Diosdado Macapagal Government Center Maimpis, San Fernando City Pampanga Page 2 of 2
